2.2 stopped shipping .wolf/reframe-frameworks.md on the grounds that the
/reframe skill carries it, but the skill only pointed at that file, so
/reframe read a missing path on 2.2+ installs. Embed the knowledge base
in the skill (loaded only when /reframe runs) and guard against drift
from the template that update still uses for legacy cleanup.

Fixes #135

installSkills treated any installed skill that differed from the new
template as user-customized, so no template fix ever reached existing
installs without a manual delete. Record the hash of what we install in
.wolf/skills-manifest.json and also accept the hashes of templates shipped
before the manifest existed; anything else is still left alone.

commits.messageBody:
Measured against OpenCode 2.0.32 with a probe plugin that records the
real hook and event payloads, and checked against the @opencode/plugin
2.x schema. Nothing here depends on a model or provider.

- Tool inputs name the file "path", not "filePath": reads and edits
  were never recorded. Accept path first, keep the V1 keys.
- A successful turn ends with session.execution.succeeded; session.idle
  was never delivered (run and serve), so turns never stopped (no
  session-end line, no ledger entry). Treat execution.succeeded as a
  turn end and dedupe per session so idle plus succeeded stops once.
- session.usage.updated carries cumulative session totals without a
  model; recording each one over-counted. Record per-step usage from
  session.step.ended and session.step.failed (failed steps can still be
  billed), with the model from session.step.started, plus title and
  compaction usage from session.usage.recorded.
- Read results carry the raw file text in output.content; content[] adds
  a header and line numbers, which skewed token estimates and read
  fingerprints.
- session.created is not delivered for a session that existed before the
  plugin subscribed (first session of run, --continue, serve). Start the
  session on first contact, before other handlers create its file.
- Resubscribe with capped backoff when the event stream fails or ends.
- Skip failed tool calls in execute.after (a failed edit changed
  nothing) and keep hook exceptions from failing the agent's tool call.

Add tests/opencode-v2-runtime.test.ts driving index-v2.ts through a fake
plugin context; nine of its tests fail without this change.
commits.messageHeadline: fix(opencode): make the V2 plugin track real OpenCode 2 sessions
